source.publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration
source.title: O*NET 31.0 Database

permitted_use: Qualitative validation of broad, preregistered role-skill patterns after model-only analysis is frozen.
prohibited_uses: claims about workers, vacancies, labour markets, causality or historical demand
separation_note: O*NET is a contemporary occupational information system, not historical validation for model cutoff periods. Its sampling errors and ratings are outside the model estimand.
